story_type: unarmed ICBM test launch at night, tracking camera close-ups
hook: An unarmed nuclear missile, fired across the Pacific on purpose.
narration: This unarmed nuclear missile was picked at random and fired across the Pacific.
On May twentieth, it blasted out of a silo at Vandenberg, California.
Minuteman Three burns solid fuel, so it can wait in a silo for years, ready to launch on short notice.
It carried one test reentry vehicle.
outcome: It flew about forty two hundred miles to a test range in the Marshall Islands.
title: Minuteman III fired across the Pacific
description:
Air Force Global Strike Command Airmen launch an unarmed Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile on an operational test from Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, on May 20, 2026.

Footage: U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Ian Hawkes, Space Launch Delta 30, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1008479/gt256-minuteman-icbm-test-launch-narrated
